beats.text: Five classic novels that genuinely earn the hype — and pair with our full videos.
One. Pride and Prejudice — Austen's razor wit, hiding one of literature's great love stories.
Two. Crime and Punishment — Dostoevsky locks you inside a murderer's unravelling mind.
Three. Jane Eyre — a small, plain, fierce heroine who refuses to be owned by anyone.
Four. Frankenstein — a teenager invented science fiction, and asked who the real monster is.
Five. The Great Gatsby — the American dream, gorgeous on the surface, hollow underneath.
Start with any one. Full retellings of all five are on the channel.
